title: Processing Frozen Human Blood for Population-Scale DNA Sequencing
author: Jackson Mingle
materials: 2 mL Buffer CW1 per well Plate
2 mL Buffer CW2 per well Plate

Thaw the following reagents at room temperature: Sequencing Buffer (SB) Library Solution (LIS) Flow Cell Tether (FCT) Flow Cell Flush (FCF) Elution Buffer (EB) Mix by vortexing, spin down, and place on ice.

Thaw the following reagents at room temperature: Sequencing Buffer (SB) Library Solution (LIS) Flow Cell Tether (FCT) Flow Cell Flush (FCF) Elution Buffer (EB) Wash Diluent (DIL) Mix by vortexing, spin down, and place on ice.
Pause the sequencing run in MinKNOW.
Wait 00:10:00 before resuming sequencing run in MinKNOW.

steps.title: Thaw and Prepare Blood Samples
steps.instruction: Thaw blood samples from -80 °C at 37 °C for 15 minutes using a water bath or dry block heater. Mix by inversion 15-20x immediately before use.

substeps.instruction: If sample volume > 1 mL, aliquot 1 mL into 1.5 mL Eppendorf DNA LoBind tubes and store at -80 °C.

steps.title: Prepare KingFisher Apex 24 Plates
steps.instruction: Set up the deep-well plates for the KingFisher Apex 24 instrument.

substeps.instruction: Plate 1 (Lysis/Binding): Add samples and reagents as specified in the Lysis/Binding Plate preparation step.
Plate 2 (Nanobind Storage): Place one 5 mm Nanobind disk per well at the bottom.
Plate 3 (Wash 1): 2 mL Buffer CW1 per well (add 96–100% ethanol to concentrate as per bottle).
Plate 4 (Wash 2): 2 mL Buffer CW2 per well (add 96–100% ethanol to concentrate as per bottle).
Plate 5 (Wash 3): 2 mL Buffer CW2 per well.
Plate 6 (Elution): 200 µL Buffer EB per well.
Plate 7 (Tip Plate): KingFisher Apex 24 deep-well tip comb.

steps.title: Prepare Lysis/Binding Plate
steps.instruction: Add reagents to the Lysis/Binding Plate in the following strict order:

substeps.instruction: Add 100 µL Proteinase K per well.
Add 1 mL whole blood per well (inversion mix 15-20x immediately prior).
Add 100 µL RNase A per well.
Add 750 µL Buffer BL3 per well, adding gently against the side of the well.

steps.title: Run KingFisher Apex Extraction
steps.instruction: Execute the DNA extraction on the KingFisher Apex instrument.

substeps.instruction: Ensure instrument is set up with 24 Combi magnetic head and 24 deep-well heating block.
Select the '1mL_Blood_Nanobind_HT_APEX' script.
Insert plates as indicated on the display and press 'Next' after each plate.
When prompted (~50 minutes after start), remove the Lysis/Binding Plate, gently add 1.5 mL isopropanol to each well against the side, re-insert, and press 'Next'.

steps.title: Recover and Homogenize Eluate
steps.instruction: Collect the DNA eluate and ensure it is fully solubilized.

substeps.instruction: When prompted, remove the Elution Plate and transfer eluate to new 1.5 mL Eppendorf DNA LoBind tubes.
Transfer any residual eluate from the tip comb plate to the same tubes.
Let eluate rest overnight at room temperature.
Pipette-mix 10x with a standard P200 pipette to disrupt any unsolubilized 'jellies'.

steps.title: Post-Extraction Quality Control
steps.instruction: Verify DNA quantity and size before shearing.

substeps.instruction: Optional: Size on Agilent Femto Pulse (Genomic DNA 165 kb kit); expected size >100kb.
Optional: Quantify with NanoDrop 8000 (2 µL DNA).
Quantify with Qubit Flex (Qubit 1x dsDNA BR Assay, 2 µL DNA).

steps.title: Shear DNA with Megaruptor 3
steps.instruction: Shear DNA to target N50 of 35-45 kb.

substeps.instruction: Prepare 6-10.5 µg DNA in 150 µL Buffer EB (concentration 40-70 ng/µL) in a Megaruptor 3 shearing tube.
Attach the Megaruptor 3 shearing syringe (ensure plunger is compressed) to the tube cap.
Load samples and syringes onto the instrument (balance odd numbers with empty tubes).
Run at speed 20 for a total of 2 runs, entering 150 µL volume and sample concentration.
Remove samples and disassemble the needle/syringe, ensuring the plunger is fully depressed to recover all volume.
Optional: Size on Agilent Femto Pulse (Genomic DNA 165 kb kit); expected range 40-100 kb.
Optional: Quantify with Qubit Flex (Qubit 1x dsDNA BR Assay, 1 µL DNA).
Store at 4 °C (or -80 °C for long-term) until size selection. Minimum 6 µg DNA required for shearing; minimum 2.5 µg for library prep.

steps.title: Size Selection
steps.instruction: Perform size selection to achieve 40-100kb range.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge at 10,000 x g for 30 minutes at room temperature (hinge facing outside of rotor).
Start a second centrifuge run at 23,100 x g for 10 minutes prior to the end of the previous step.
Remove tubes and carefully remove supernatant without disturbing the pellet (pellet is under the hinge region).
Incubate for 1 hour at 50 °C in Thermomixer.
Add equal volume Buffer SRE, vortex for 10 seconds, and spin down.
Incubate for 20 minutes at room temperature.
Add 55 µL Buffer LTE (adjust volume for desired concentration).
Pipette-mix 20x, vortex for 5 seconds, and spin down.
Size on Agilent Femto Pulse (Genomic DNA 165 kb kit); expected range 40-100kb, DQN > 9.8.
Quantify with Qubit Flex (Qubit 1x dsDNA BR Assay, 2 µL DNA).

steps.title: Library Preparation (Manual/Hamilton)
steps.instruction: Prepare the DNA library using LSK-114 reagents.

substeps.instruction: Prepare DNA: 2.5 µg DNA in 48 µL nuclease-free water in 0.2 mL PCR tube (or BioRad Hard-Shell plate for Hamilton).

Prepare DNA repair enzyme master mix: 3.5 µL NEBNext FFPE DNA Repair Buffer, 3.5 µL Ultra II End-Prep Reaction Buffer, 2 µL NEBNext FFPE DNA Repair Mix, and 3 µL Ultra II End-Prep Enzyme Mix. Mix gently 10x.
Add 12 µL DNA repair enzyme master mix to DNA, pipette-mix/flick 10x, and spin down.
Incubate at 20 °C for 30 minutes, then 65 °C for 5 minutes in a thermocycler.
Incubate on platform rocker for 5 minutes at room temperature.
Perform AMPure XP bead cleanup: Add 60 µL (or equal volume) resuspended beads, flick mix 10x, spin down, and incubate on magnetic rack for 2 minutes.
Wash beads: Add 200 µL 80% ethanol, wait 5 seconds, remove ethanol, and dry for ~30 seconds.
Elute: Add 60 µL nuclease-free water, flick mix 10x, spin down, and incubate at 37 °C and 450 rpm for 3 minutes in Thermomixer.
Transfer 60 µL of eluate to a new 1.5 mL Eppendorf DNA LoBind tube.
Prepare ligation enzyme master mix: 25 µL Ligation Buffer, 10 µL Quick T4 DNA Ligase, 5 µL Ligation Adapter. Mix gently 10x.
Add 40 µL ligation enzyme master mix to DNA, pipette-mix/flick 10x, and spin down.
Incubate at 37 °C and 450 rpm for 20 minutes in Thermomixer.
Incubate on platform rocker for 5 minutes at room temperature.
Perform second AMPure XP cleanup: Add 45 µL resuspended beads, flick mix 10x, spin down, and incubate for 30 minutes at room temperature.
Wash beads: Add 250 µL Short Fragment Buffer, remove supernatant, then wash with 80% ethanol, and dry for ~30 seconds.
Elute: Add 26 µL Elution Buffer, flick mix 10x, and spin down.
Transfer 26 µL eluate to a new 1.5 mL Eppendorf DNA LoBind tube.
Quantify with Qubit Flex (Qubit 1X dsDNA HS Assay, 1 µL DNA).

steps.title: PromethION Flow Cell Priming and Loading
steps.instruction: Prime the flow cell and load the prepared library.

substeps.instruction: Prepare flow cell priming mix: 1170 µL Flow Cell Flush and 30 µL Flow Cell Tether per sample; vortex.
Prepare flow cell wash mix: 398 µL Wash Diluent and 2 µL Wash Mix per sample; pipette-mix (do not vortex).
Warm flow cells at room temperature for 20 minutes; check for condensation and ensure heat pad is present.
Perform flow cell check (minimum 6500 pores).
Load 400 µL wash mix via inlet port, close valve, and remove waste buffer from waste port 2 or 3.
Load 500 µL priming mix via inlet port. Open inlet port and draw back 20-30 µL to remove air bubbles.
Add 68 µL Library Solution (LIS) and 100 µL Sequencing Buffer (SB).
Prepare 300 ng DNA library in 32 µL Elution Buffer; mix gently by pipetting 5x.
Load 200 µL of library into the inlet port using a P1000 pipette.
Close valve, install light shield, and close PromethION door.

steps.title: Sequencing Run
steps.instruction: Initiate and monitor the sequencing run in MinKNOW.

substeps.instruction: Wait 10 minutes before initiating run.
Configure: Kit SQK-LSK114-XL, Fast basecalling, 72 or 96 hour run, raw reads .POD5, min Q score 8.
Monitor pore occupancy and scan results within the first hour. If issues occur, perform pore scan or re-insert flow cell.
For subsequent loads (up to 3 loads), recover DNA library if necessary and repeat priming/loading steps.
